name: mobile
description: LilChess Mobile: Capacitor shell around the web client.

scripts.build:web: npm run build --prefix ../shared && npm run build:native --prefix ../web
scripts.sync: npm run build:web && cap sync && node scripts/normalize-spm-paths.mjs
scripts.run:android: npm run sync && cap run android
scripts.run:ios: npm run sync && cap run ios
